about_the_game:
Once upon a time, there was a deep forest, as beautiful as it was dangerous.

One day, the king of a distant land came to conquer the forest, build a kingdom, and harness its ancient power as his own. 

Then broke out a devastating war of 10 years between the king’s forces and the forest in whence the king was killed, along with many of the forest’s mythical beasts.


A fragile treaty was struck between the headstrong prince and Kunie, the legendary forest warrior. The prince would keep his kingdom, and the forest would be left to regrow in peace.


But then something happened. Something that risked the peace and plunged the land into peril. 


Something that no one could predict, and all were powerless to stop. 


The prince fell madly in love with the warrior Kunie.

Features

  • Zombies. 

  • A problematic love story that involves a fiery death machine

  • A new unlockable soulmask character that you were NOT expecting

  • Music that makes you feel all fuzzy inside

  • Even more faces, cards, and eyeballs

  • Some poetry that doesn't land very well
